London School of Economics and Political Science

Department of Management
MG478

The Management of People in Global Companies

MSc · Convenor · LSE course guide

Core course on the MSc in Human Resources and Organisations, examining how strategy (namely game theory), culture, and technology shape the management of people in multinational firms.

University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign

School of Labor and Employment Relations
LER 565

Game Theory and HR Strategy

Graduate · Summer 2026

Six weeks of applied game theory for human resources — sequential and zero-sum play, the prisoner's dilemma, coordination, information asymmetries, and strategic moves. Each week runs as a lecture and a live session.
